title: claytonia polyandra

It is native to the western regions of North America, particularly in the mountainous areas of British Columbia and Alberta in Canada, as well as in the western United States. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat gastrointestinal issues, and its leaves have been consumed for their health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The bioactive constituents of Claytonia polyandra include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
